title: acre-gui opens several files at launch
body:
`acre-gui` took one optional `file` and opened the last drawing when none was given. Opening more meant File > Open after launch.

## Proposal

`Cli::files` in `main.rs` is a `Vec<PathBuf>`, and `App::new` opens each one in its own tab, in order, so the last one named is shown. When none are named, `App::new` opens the first file in `Recent` as before. Each file shown clears the status line, so `App::new` holds back the first failure and shows it once every file is open.
close_reason: Landed in 6723e0f. acre-gui opens each file named in its own tab, with the last one in front.
